description: This file is a shell script library for setting up and managing an HTTP server used in testing scenarios. It includes functions to start and stop a web server, configure SSL, enable features like DAV and HTTP/2, prepare server environment, and perform various test assertions related to HTTP and Git interactions.

methods.name: install_script
methods.description: Helper function to copy test scripts into the server root directory.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts the HTTP server with the configured parameters for testing.

methods.name: prepare_httpd
methods.description: Prepares the HTTP server environment, including configuration and SSL setup if needed.

methods.name: enable_http2
methods.description: Enables HTTP/2 support in the server configuration.

methods.name: enable_cgipassauth
methods.description: Configures the server to support CGIPassAuth if the server version is appropriate.
